rows.text: Charged $14.99 to Morgan's card, paid to Nomiq Domains.
rows.quote: Renewed halcyonthreshold.org (was expiring in 3 days) — $14.99, charged to your Visa.

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Idris Bellamy <grants@emberfallfund.org> with subject "Re: Rapid grants — yes, you can still apply". It read: "Hi Idris, Great meeting you too. Thank you for the details — we're putting together a proposal (a project to map which frontier-AI risks are actually being evaluated today vs. which are neglected, plus a pilot eval) and will have it to you well before 30 November. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Sent Idris Bellamy a holding reply (proposal coming, no commitment made).

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Corvid Institute <ops@corvidinstitute.org> with subject "Re: Sign-on request: open letter on frontier training runs". It read: "Hi, Thanks for thinking of Halcyon Threshold. I'm not able to be listed as a signatory right now — I have a pending review with my employer about outside roles and public statements, and I'd rather get that sorted before my name goes out with a letter that goes to press. I'd like to stay in the loop for future letters once that's resolved. Appreciate the invitation either way. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Declined — politely, door left open — the Corvid Institute open-letter sign-on

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thanks for thinking of Halcyon Threshold for this. I'm not able to go on record by name right now — I have a pending review with my employer about outside roles and public statements that I need to clear first. I know that doesn't help your deadline tomorrow, sorry. If you're doing more reporting on this beat later on, I'd be glad to talk once that's resolved. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: and the Larkin Dispatch press request, both citing your pending employer review

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Really glad to have you. Here's something concrete to start with, if it sounds good: A landscape survey of frontier-AI risk evaluations — basically: what's actually being measured today (deception, cyber/bio uplift, situational awareness, autonomous replication, persuasion, etc.), by whom, with links to the benchmarks/papers, and — more importantly — what's discussed a lot but nobody is actually measuring. I'd like a simple table plus a short \"here's the most interesting gap\" section. No rush to make it polished — rough and honest beats comprehensive. Would two weeks from now be reasonable given your five hours a week? I'll share a doc for us to work in together. One heads-up: I'm mid-way through an internal review at my day job about outside roles, so for now this is quiet/internal work rather than anything public — I'll let you know the moment that changes. Thanks again for reaching out, Morgan"
rows.quote: Replied to Priya Raman with a concrete first task (survey of existing AI-risk evals vs. gaps)
